title: Data transfer costs: in, out, across AZs and Regions

kcs.statement: Data transfer into AWS from the internet is free, while data transferred out to the internet is charged per GB, with the per-GB rate falling at higher monthly volumes.
Traffic between Availability Zones and between Regions is charged per GB, while traffic within one AZ over private IP addresses is free, so multi-AZ and cross-Region designs add transfer cost.
Data transfer from AWS origins such as S3 or EC2 to CloudFront is free, so serving content through CloudFront can lower data-out costs compared with serving directly from the origin.
